text: Jory Bones! Lucky Jory, they call me. Ironic, mostly. Roll the bones with me?
Feel lucky, {player}? I always do. It's never once been true.
Two dice, high roll doubles your stake. Simplest game on the sea.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Up with the gulls, I see.

options.label: Let's roll. (Bet what's in my purse, up to 16 doubloons)
How did you get the name?

text: Won a sloop off a Tidewatch lieutenant with a pair of sixes. Lost it next morning on a pair of ones. Nobody remembers the second part.
Never bet the ship. Never bet on a cursed man's dice. And never, ever play cards with the dealer in the corner. He counts.
Luck's like wind. You can't make it, but you can be there when it blows.
